headline: Knicks Lead Tonight's NBA Slate
caption:
Three games tonight, and our model's surest call is New York at 74% over Philadelphia.

The projection has the Knicks 114.9 to the 76ers' 107.5. Still not a lock: Philly wins this about 1 time in 4.

The one to watch is Oklahoma City at San Antonio, a near coin flip. The model leans Spurs at just 52%, with a projected 113.3 to 112.7. Over in Detroit, the Pistons get the nod at 59% over Boston, 109.7 to 107.1.

Swipe for every pick and projected score. Which call would you flip?

games.game: Oklahoma City Thunder at San Antonio Spurs
